qualificationRule: Each native backend passed the controlled-draw comparison in headed Chrome. The natural comparison records which spans exceeded the distance between two publisher takes.

pronunciationOracle.source: Pronunciation audit of all 86 spans in the pinned Persian article.

originalNaturalControl.comparisonMethod: Two publisher WASM takes give a reference distance for each span. We matched the native audio to source spans by minimum distance and recorded a failure whenever the candidate distance exceeded the reference.

publisherControl.meaning: Both comparisons use the original publisher WASM graph as the reference.

scope.controlledReplay: We compared the acoustic inputs and durations for each utterance, then sent the same model draw through both postprocessors and compared the final Float32 PCM bytes for each span.
scope.timing: The native generation time covers three source spans. Full-article timing uses separate benchmark runs.
scope.speechQuality: These checks measure adapter fidelity. Subjective listening quality was unmeasured.
